# Security

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Eyebrowse, please report it
privately to security@eyebrowse.in rather than opening a public issue.

Please include what you did, what happened, and the app version from Settings, About.
We will acknowledge the report and tell you what we intend to do about it.

This file covers the Eyebrowse app and this repository. It does not cover GeckoView or
Mozilla's application-services binaries, which are reported upstream to Mozilla.
